name: Winampfy
tagline: Nostalgic Winamp 2.x skinned desktop frontend for your Spotify library
description: Winampfy brings back the golden age of desktop audio players by combining the classic, pixel-perfect Winamp 2.9 UI with modern Spotify streaming, visualizers, and EQ presets.
features: Authentic Winamp 2.x interface with working spectrum analyzer and EQ
Direct integration with Spotify Web API
Minimal CPU footprint and nostalgic window snapping
